interview.name: Cleo
interview.answer: The repair drive’s time and location aren’t specified in the notes.

reflections: Mina is proactive and willing to help by bringing supplies.
Cleo is coordinating the repair drive and tracking what is still needed.
Bo relies on Cleo for status updates and support with the missing items.
Cleo is a steady coordinator who keeps tracking supplies and missing items for the repair effort.
Bo, Pia, and Rosa rely on Cleo to stay informed and help connect supply status with repair priorities.
The group is coordinating around a shared repair drive, with Rosa focusing on urgent safety fixes and the others contributing timing, supplies, and status updates.
Cleo is a dependable coordinator who follows through on practical tasks like supplies checks, address verification, and routing information to the right person.
Rosa is prioritizing urgent safety work first, while keeping the repair list organized and linked to missing supplies.
Quinn is focused on outreach and recruitment, helping connect volunteers and resources to the repair effort.
Cleo is acting as the organizer who tracks details, supplies, and logistics for the repair drive.
Opal and Pia are waiting on specific information before they can finish or relay the rest of their parts.
Quinn and Uli are contributing practical help, with Uli preferring to start small and keep the effort low-key.
Cleo is acting as a coordination hub, tracking supplies, details, and missing items for the group.
The people involved are cooperating smoothly, with multiple members offering concrete help and quick follow-through.
Mara, Pia, and Mina each appear to rely on Cleo for status tracking and shared updates as the event comes together.

events.text: Mina: How’s the repair drive going? Do you need me to bring anything by?
events.speaker: Mina

events.text: Cleo: It’s going pretty well, thanks. If you can bring tape and a box of screws, that’d help a lot.
events.speaker: Cleo

events.text: Mina: Sure — I can drop off tape and a box of screws later today. Anything else you need?
events.speaker: Mina

events.text: Cleo: I can keep an eye on what we’ve got and note what’s still needed for the repair drive.
events.speaker: Cleo

events.text: Bo: Thanks, Cleo — that’d help a lot. Just keep me posted on what’s still missing.
events.speaker: Bo

events.text: Cleo: Will do — I’ll check our supplies and let you know what we’re still missing.
events.speaker: Cleo

events.text: Pia: I’m still trying to pin down the timing and drop-off details, but I’ll let you know as soon as I have a date. Once that’s set, I can plan around it properly.
events.speaker: Pia

events.text: Cleo: Thanks, Pia — just let me know the date when you have it, and I’ll keep tracking what we still need.
events.speaker: Cleo

events.text: Pia: Thanks, Cleo — I will. I’m just waiting on the timing and drop-off details, and I’ll pass them along as soon as they’re set.
events.speaker: Pia

events.text: Rosa: Absolutely — I’m starting with the urgent safety fixes first and then the usability repairs. If you hear of anything specific, send it my way.
events.speaker: Rosa

events.text: Cleo: Sounds good — I’ll keep checking our supplies and let you know if we’re missing anything else.
events.speaker: Cleo

events.text: Rosa: Thanks, Cleo — that’ll help a lot. I’ll keep the priority list updated, and we can match any missing supplies to the urgent repairs.
events.speaker: Rosa

events.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll keep spreading the word and let neighbors know we’re looking for volunteers with tools, spare parts, and a hand sorting repairs on Saturday.
events.speaker: Quinn

prov.value: The repair drive is being held on Saturday at the front porch.

events.text: Cleo: Thanks, Quinn — that’d be a big help. I’ll keep track of any tools or spare parts people mention and pass along what’s still needed.
events.speaker: Cleo

events.text: Quinn: Perfect, Cleo — I’ll keep inviting folks and send anyone your way with tools or spare parts.
events.speaker: Quinn

events.text: Opal: Thanks, Cleo — could you check the community hall address and parking access first? Once that’s confirmed, I’ll fill in the rest of the repair drive details.
events.speaker: Opal

events.text: Cleo: Sure — I’ll check the address and parking access now, then I’ll send you the details.
events.speaker: Cleo

events.text: Opal: Perfect, thanks, Cleo — once you send those, I’ll fill in the rest of the repair drive details.
events.speaker: Opal

events.text: Uli: Yeah — keep it low-key, and I can help with the gate latch first, then the faucet if I’ve got the energy.
events.speaker: Uli

events.text: Cleo: Got it — I’ll keep track of what we still need and note the gate latch first. If you run short on anything, just tell me and I’ll add it to the list.
events.speaker: Cleo

events.text: Uli: Thanks, Cleo — that helps. I’ll start with the gate latch and let you know if I can take on the faucet too.
events.speaker: Uli

events.text: Cleo: Thanks, Pia — I’ll keep tracking supplies, and I’ll send the hall address and parking info as soon as I confirm it.
events.speaker: Cleo

events.text: Pia: Thanks, Cleo — I’m still waiting on the timing and drop-off details, but once I have them I’ll pass everything along right away.
events.speaker: Pia

events.text: Cleo: Sounds good — I’ll keep an eye on our supplies and send over the hall address and parking details as soon as I confirm them.
events.speaker: Cleo

events.text: Mina: Sounds good — I’ll bring the tape and box of screws later today. Let me know if anything else comes up.
events.speaker: Mina

events.text: Cleo: Thanks, Mina — I’ve got those noted, and I’ll keep tracking any other supplies we still need.
events.speaker: Cleo

events.text: Mina: Great, thanks — I’ll check in later today in case anything else is needed.
events.speaker: Mina

events.text: Mara: Yes — it’s still on for today, and we could use help sorting donations or setting up the tables. I’ll keep everyone posted if anything changes.
events.speaker: Mara

events.text: Cleo: I’ll keep track of what comes in and note any gaps. If you spot anything we’re missing for the tables or donations, send it my way.
events.speaker: Cleo

events.text: Mara: That’s a huge help, Cleo — I’ll let you know if anything’s missing. Thanks for keeping an eye on the tables and donations.
events.speaker: Mara
